title: Adverbs of Time
intro:
Adverb of time menjelaskan kapan sesuatu terjadi: yesterday, today, tomorrow, now, later, soon, already. Biasanya diletakkan di akhir kalimat, kadang di awal untuk penekanan.
I saw him yesterday.
We will leave soon.
Tomorrow she starts school.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct adverb of time
exercises.question: I saw that movie ___.
exercises.explanation: Kata kerja saw adalah bentuk lampau, jadi keterangan waktunya juga lampau: yesterday.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct adverb of time
exercises.question: She will call you ___.
exercises.explanation: Will menandakan masa depan, jadi keterangan waktunya later, bukan waktu lampau.

exercises.prompt: Match each adverb to its time
exercises.explanation: Yesterday dan last week menunjuk masa lalu, now menunjuk sekarang, sedangkan tomorrow dan soon menunjuk masa depan.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence with the correct verb form
exercises.explanation: 'Last month' menandakan waktu lampau, jadi kata kerjanya went.

exercises.question: They are eating ___.
exercises.explanation: Present continuous menandakan kegiatan yang sedang berlangsung, jadi keterangannya now.

exercises.explanation: Gunakan bentuk lampau dengan keterangan waktu di akhir, misalnya 'I studied English yesterday.'
